svg.title: Which Storage Scale System fits
svg.desc: The two Storage Scale System models and the expansion enclosure, what each is for and the most raw capacity it holds: Storage Scale System 3500, 2U, IBM’s entry and mid-level system, up to 126 GB/s, 737.28 TB; Storage Scale System 6000, 4U, for the most demanding AI, HPC and analytics work, up to 340 GB/s, 4.7 PB; All-Flash Expansion Enclosure, 2U, up to three on a 6000, up to 100 GB/s each, more than 3 PB.
